decision: Wave40 plus the wave42 recovery complete the valid seed-0 2x2 adaptive-GAR factorial. On 2,873 held-out states and 14,365 broad candidates per cell, predicted-hard selection is worse than random under both teachers: pairwise ranking accuracy is 0.6217 versus 0.7141 with terminal-privileged exact-distance targets and 0.6853 versus 0.7708 with latent-distance targets. Exact-distance supervision is also worse than latent supervision in each matched selection arm, while hard plus exact nearly collapses (state effective rank 6.57 versus 103.56 for hard plus latent). Therefore do not retrain or seed-scale either factor. The predeclared closed-loop gate is absent from the completed artifacts, so run only the same checkpoint-only evaluator on all four cells with identical test seed, 64 examples, 256 candidates, and 8 receding steps. Reject hard selection and exact supervision unless the closed-loop results reverse their matched ranking losses without worse invalid-action or loop rates; otherwise retain random selection with latent-distance supervision as the diagnostic baseline and redirect the next training decision away from candidate mining and privileged teachers. Exact-distance cells remain explicitly terminal-privileged training diagnostics; oracle-injected evaluator conditions remain candidate-privileged diagnostics and cannot support a deployment-feasible claim.
